card.name: Digits after the dot in section numbers
card.fires_on: A single digit right after a period in a numbered reference, such as section numbers (2.4, 10.2) or the start of a DOI (10.3389). It fires on the digit following the dot.

modes.label: Section cross-references
modes.description: Digit after the dot in a section number cited in parentheses or in a heading.

modes.label: DOI numbers
modes.description: First digit after 10. at the start of a DOI.
